name: Civitai Radio
tagline: Play Civitai collections like a music player.
description:
Civitai Radio plays the videos in a Civitai collection one after another, like a music player. It starts with the Music Focus collection. Your own collections appear beside it, and any public collection opens from its link.

Shuffle and repeat, a queue that shows what already played, keyboard shortcuts, and media keys and lock-screen controls where your browser allows them. The Details tab shows how the current video was made: its prompt, settings and resources. Reaction counts and comments link back to Civitai.

The app only reads collections. It never changes them, and it remembers nothing between visits.
